parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN split_part($1, '_', 2) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN split_part($1, '_', 2)::int END AS rid,
         CASE WHEN split_part($1, '_', 3) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN split_part($1, '_', 3)::int END AS idx
),
pick AS (
  SELECT pr.reporte_id, pr.candidatos -> p.idx AS c
  FROM p
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT reporte_id, candidatos FROM predicciones WHERE reporte_id = p.rid ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON true
  WHERE p.idx IS NOT NULL
)
UPDATE reportes r
SET clase_corregida = pick.c ->> 'clase',
    confianza = (pick.c ->> 'confianza')::float,
    subclase = NULLIF(pick.c ->> 'categoria', 'pendiente'),
    estado = 'completado'
FROM pick
WHERE r.id = pick.reporte_id AND r.chat_id = $2 AND r.estado = 'esperando_objeto' AND pick.c IS NOT NULL
RETURNING r.id, r.clase_corregida, r.subclase, r.confianza;

UPDATE reportes
SET estado = 'esperando_nombre'
WHERE id = (CASE WHEN split_part($1, '_', 2) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN split_part($1, '_', 2)::int END)
  AND chat_id = $2 AND estado = 'esperando_objeto'
RETURNING id;
